name: Router & Switch Security Assessment
description: Ability to assess the security of routers and switches in network infrastructure. Covers device configuration review, management plane security (SSH, SNMP, console access), routing protocol security, switch port security, VLAN configuration, and identification of common misconfigurations.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to router and switch security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands basic router and switch functionality and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain routing and switching fundamentals (ARP, VLANs, OSPF, BGP)
Understands common management access methods and their security implications
Knows major router/switch platforms (Cisco IOS, Juniper, Arista)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic network device security assessment under supervision
evidence: Reviews device configurations against security baselines under guidance
Checks management plane security (SSH version, SNMP community strings, AAA)
Identifies basic misconfigurations (default credentials, unencrypted management)
Documents device assessment findings under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses network device security and identifies operational risks
evidence: Performs comprehensive configuration review across device types and vendors
Assesses routing protocol security (authentication, filtering, route injection risks)
Evaluates switch security features (port security, DHCP snooping, DAI, 802.1X)
Produces actionable reports with risk-rated findings and remediation guidance

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex multi-vendor environments; develops assessment automation; mentors others
evidence: Develops automated configuration audit tools and compliance checks
Identifies advanced attack vectors through routing and switching misconfigurations
Mentors junior staff on network device assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines device assessment methodology; deep platform expertise; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's router and switch assessment methodology
Deep expertise across multiple network platforms and operating systems
Published research on network device vulnerabilities or configuration security
Trains teams on network device security assessment and hardening

assessment_methods.description: Assess a multi-device lab network and produce a comprehensive security report covering all router and switch configurations
Review network device assessment reports from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy
